label: Gemini 4 (medium) + structured skills
description: Replays of recorded Gemini 4 (medium reasoning) episodes from the final merged evaluation run, using the structured skill interface. Each video replays one recorded episode; it is not a new model run, and the outcome is the native strict-success result of that episode.

entries.title: Living Room Setup
entries.instruction: Set up the living room for me.
entries.personaDescription: A places remote on right sofa, folded blanket on armrest, drink on coffee table.

entries.title: Living Room Setup
entries.instruction: Set up the living room for me.
entries.personaDescription: B places remote on coffee table, blanket on sofa, drink on side table.

entries.title: Personalized Container Stacking
entries.personaDescription: I prioritize safety. Arrange the four containers as two low stacks of no more than two containers each, with heavier containers below lighter ones.

entries.title: Personalized Container Stacking
entries.personaDescription: I prioritize space efficiency. Put all four containers in one compact vertical stack, heaviest at the bottom, with every label facing me.

entries.title: Morning Medication Preparation
entries.personaDescription: A's morning tray holds the red-cap and blue-cap bottles and a glass of water; the green (evening) and yellow bottles stay in the caddy.

entries.title: Morning Medication Preparation
entries.personaDescription: B's morning tray holds the green-cap and yellow-cap bottles and the applesauce cup; the red (evening) and blue bottles and the water stay put.

entries.title: Personalized Car Key Placement
entries.personaDescription: Place my car keys at the center of the entry table.

entries.title: Personalized Car Key Placement
entries.personaDescription: Place my car keys inside the small storage box in the shoe cabinet.

entries.title: Personalized Bed Arrangement
entries.personaDescription: Use two pillows side by side at the bed head; put the remaining two in the basket.

entries.title: Personalized Bed Arrangement
entries.personaDescription: Use all four pillows upright, two per side: a rear pillow at the headboard and one in front of it.

entries.title: Personalized Plant Placement
entries.personaDescription: Put the plant on the windowsill.

entries.title: Personalized Plant Placement
entries.personaDescription: Put the plant on the plant stand.

entries.title: Personalized Phone Placement
entries.personaDescription: Put the phone on the wireless charging pad with the screen facing up.

entries.title: Personalized Phone Placement
entries.personaDescription: Put the phone in the tray with the screen facing down.

entries.title: Personalized Tablet Placement
entries.instruction: Put the tablet on the desk.
entries.personaDescription: Stand the tablet in the tablet stand with the screen facing the chair.

entries.title: Personalized Tablet Placement
entries.instruction: Put the tablet on the desk.
entries.personaDescription: Lay the tablet flat in the centre of the desk with the screen facing up.

entries.title: Personalized Magazine Placement
entries.personaDescription: Lay the magazine flat on top of the magazine pile.

entries.title: Personalized Magazine Placement
entries.personaDescription: Stand the magazine upright in the magazine rack.

entries.title: Personalized Laptop Placement
entries.instruction: Put my laptop on the desk.
entries.personaDescription: Place the laptop in the centre of the desk with the lid closed.

entries.title: Personalized Laptop Placement
entries.instruction: Put my laptop on the desk.
entries.personaDescription: Place the laptop in the centre of the desk, open the lid to about 110 degrees, with the keyboard and screen facing the chair.

entries.title: Personalized Charging Station
entries.personaDescription: Put the phone screen-up on the wireless charging pad, the earbuds case on the desk to the left of the pad, and the watch on the watch dock. Leave the desk drawer open.

entries.title: Personalized Charging Station
entries.personaDescription: Put the phone screen-down in the desk drawer and close the drawer, the earbuds case on the wireless charging pad, and the watch on the desk to the right of the pad.

entries.title: Personalized Entryway Tidying
entries.personaDescription: Stand the umbrella in the umbrella stand, put the hat on the upper shelf, and put the handbag on the bench.

entries.title: Personalized Entryway Tidying
entries.personaDescription: Lay the umbrella on the bench, put the hat in the wall cubby, and put the handbag on the upper shelf.

entries.title: Personalized Reading Corner
entries.personaDescription: Put the book on the side table with the glasses case on top of it, turn the reading lamp to full brightness (knob at 270 degrees), and leave the side-table drawer open.

entries.title: Personalized Reading Corner
entries.personaDescription: Put the book on the seat of the armchair, put the glasses case in the side-table drawer and close the drawer, and turn the reading lamp to 30% brightness (knob at 81 degrees).

entries.title: Object Transport Orientation
entries.instruction: Move this container to the target area.
entries.personaDescription: Keep the container label facing toward me during most of the transport.

entries.title: Object Transport Orientation
entries.instruction: Move this container to the target area.
entries.personaDescription: Keep the label facing away from me, toward the robot, during most of the transport.

entries.title: Personalized Waste Sorting
entries.personaDescription: I grew up with German Mülltrennung and I keep it up in this kitchen: the green bin on the left is only for glass, so the bottle goes there; the blue bin in the middle takes paper and clean packaging, so the newspaper and the rinsed can go there; the grey bin on the right is Restmüll, the residual waste. I have no Biotonne (organics bin) here, so the banana peel goes in the Restmüll, and so does the greasy takeout box, because food-soiled cardboard does not belong in paper recycling. Close all three lids when you are done; I do not like bins standing open.

entries.title: Personalized Waste Sorting
entries.personaDescription: We have single-stream recycling here in the US, so glass, cans, paper and cardboard all go together: put the bottle, the can, the newspaper and the takeout box in the blue bin in the middle. Our hauler takes greasy cardboard too, so I never bother separating it. Only the banana peel is trash; that goes in the grey bin on the right, and close that lid so it does not smell. Leave the recycling lid open, I keep tossing things in all day, and leave the green bin on the left alone, I do not use it.

entries.title: Personalized Child and Pet Safety Storage
entries.personaDescription: We have a toddler at home who climbs and opens everything, so anything dangerous or sweet goes up high behind a closed door: stand the pill bottle and the spray cleaner in the upper cabinet, lay the knife and the chocolate bar flat next to them, and close the cabinet door. The dog food can live low down in the counter drawer: lay the bag flat so the drawer shuts, and close the drawer so she can't dig into it.

entries.title: Personalized Child and Pet Safety Storage
entries.personaDescription: We have a dog and no kids. Chocolate and pills are poison for him, so the chocolate bar and the pill bottle (standing upright) go up in the upper cabinet with the door closed. The knife I keep handy: lay it flat in the countertop basket with the blade pointing away from me. The spray cleaner and his bag of food go in the low counter drawer, both lying down flat so they sit below the drawer's rim, and leave that drawer open: I feed him out of it every evening.

entries.title: Personalized Monitor Height
entries.personaDescription: I wear progressive (bifocal-style) lenses and read the screen through the lower part of them, so keep it low: stand the monitor directly on the desk in the centre, upright with the screen facing my chair, and park the riser in the back-left corner of the desk.

entries.title: Personalized Monitor Height
entries.personaDescription: I wear single-vision glasses and have a stiff neck, so I want the screen raised: put the riser in the centre of the desk and stand the monitor on top of it, upright with the screen facing my chair.

entries.title: Personalized Cutting Station
entries.personaDescription: I'm left-handed, so I hold the knife in my left hand. Put the cutting board flat at the front of the counter, centred in front of me. Lay the chef's knife flat on the counter to the left of the board with the blade pointing away from me, and put the prep bowl on the counter to the right of the board, where my free right hand scoops the chopped food into it. Put the folded towel flat at the back of the counter, behind the board.

entries.title: Personalized Cutting Station
entries.personaDescription: I'm right-handed, so I hold the knife in my right hand. Put the cutting board flat at the front of the counter, centred in front of me. Lay the chef's knife flat on the counter to the right of the board with the blade pointing away from me, and put the prep bowl on the counter to the left of the board, where my free left hand scoops the chopped food into it. Put the folded towel flat at the back of the counter, behind the board.

entries.title: Personalized Pantry Loading
entries.personaDescription: I walk with a walker and can't bend below my waist or lift anything above my shoulders, so put all four groceries on the high shelf and nothing on the low shelf: the heavy water pack and rice bag at the front edge of the high shelf, the cereal and crackers anywhere on the high shelf, everything upright.

entries.title: Personalized Pantry Loading
entries.personaDescription: I'm tall and have no trouble bending, and I store by weight so the rack stays stable: put the heavy water pack and rice bag on the low shelf and the cereal and crackers on the high shelf, everything upright.

entries.title: Personalized Tea Service
entries.personaDescription: I drink gongfu-style Chinese tea: put the teapot at the back of the tea tray with the two small handleless cups side by side in front of it, and leave the mug, the milk jug and the sugar bowl on the back shelf.

entries.title: Personalized Tea Service
entries.personaDescription: I drink English tea with milk and sugar: put the teapot, the mug, the milk jug and the sugar bowl on the tea tray, and leave the two small cups on the back shelf.

entries.title: Personalized Shelf Display
entries.personaDescription: I collect these figurines and I want the whole set on show, in story order from left to right along the display shelf at the back of the sideboard: the dragon in slot 1, the knight in slot 2, the wizard in slot 3 and the castle in slot 4, all standing upright. Nothing goes in the storage box; close its lid.

entries.title: Personalized Shelf Display
entries.personaDescription: I like a bare, uncluttered sideboard with just one piece on show: stand my favourite, the dragon, upright on its own in the centre of the display shelf, and put the knight, the wizard and the castle away inside the storage box, then close the lid.

entries.title: Personalized Masonry Workbench Setup
entries.personaDescription: Place both tiles flat on the left, the trowel on the right, and the material box at the back.

entries.title: Personalized Masonry Workbench Setup
entries.personaDescription: Place both tiles flat on the right, the trowel on the left, and the material box at the front.

entries.title: Personalized Shared-Hallway Pickup
entries.personaDescription: Put the car key fob and the sunglasses case in the left basket and leave the other four items where they are (User A drives to work; the left basket is theirs).

entries.title: Personalized Shared-Hallway Pickup
entries.personaDescription: Put the earbuds case and the running cap in the middle basket and leave the other four items where they are (User B runs every morning; the middle basket is theirs).

entries.title: Personalized Shared-Hallway Pickup
entries.personaDescription: Put the paperback and the reading-glasses case in the right basket and leave the other four items where they are (User C is reading for a book club; the right basket is theirs).

entries.title: Personalized Stove Setup
entries.instruction: Put the pots on the stove.
entries.personaDescription: Put the stock pot on the back-left burner and the saucepan on the back-right burner with its handle pointing toward the back wall (User A has a toddler who could grab a handle sticking out over the front edge).

entries.title: Personalized Stove Setup
entries.instruction: Put the pots on the stove.
entries.personaDescription: Put the stock pot on the front-left burner and the saucepan on the front-right burner with its handle pointing right, parallel to the front edge (User B cooks from a wheelchair and cannot reach over a front pot to the back burners).

entries.title: Personalized Stove Setup
entries.instruction: Put the pots on the stove.
entries.personaDescription: Put the saucepan on the front-left burner with its handle pointing left, parallel to the front edge, and the stock pot on the back-right burner (User C is left-handed and lifts and pours the saucepan with the left hand).

entries.title: Sliding Curtain Privacy
entries.personaDescription: Open both curtain panels fully to admit daylight.

entries.title: Sliding Curtain Privacy
entries.personaDescription: Open the left panel but close the right panel for side privacy.

entries.title: Sliding Curtain Privacy
entries.personaDescription: Close both panels for privacy.

entries.title: Pet Feeding Station
entries.personaDescription: Put the food bowl on the left and water on the right on the floor mat for my small pet.

entries.title: Pet Feeding Station
entries.personaDescription: Use the raised feeder for my larger pet, with water on the left and food on the right.

entries.title: Serving Cart Arrangement
entries.personaDescription: Keep both drinks on the upper shelf for quick access and the snack on the lower shelf.

entries.title: Serving Cart Arrangement
entries.personaDescription: Keep the upper shelf clear as a serving workspace; put both drinks and the snack below.
